'''Sugihara Shrine''' (すぎはらじんじゃ) is a shrine located in Kuroda, Yatsuo-chō, {{ill|Toyama (city)|Q204266|qid=Q204266}}, {{ill|Toyama Prefecture|Q132929|qid=Q132929}}.

=== History ===
Its founding date is unknown, but it is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448}}.
